title: 第18章 廊内交涉
novel_title: 修炼就修炼，你们别总想留宿啊
content_zh:
走廊里的灵石灯闪了一下。

    林尘后背贴着拐角处的石壁，匕首横在胸前，刀刃上还残留着宋芹锁骨上蹭下来的暗紫色血渍。

    十七步之外，唐玉的脚步声从走廊另一头往这边来，软底靴踩在石板上节奏很稳，不急不缓。

    十三步之外，密室门口的方向，宋芹拖曳在地面上的布料摩擦声停了一瞬，然后又响起来，比刚才更近了一些。

    “你是不是想用最后一次瞬身步冲出去？”

    宋芹的声音从走廊尽头传来，沙哑中带着一种念蜕之后特有的愉悦，像是嗓子被毒素浸泡过之后重新长出了一层新的黏膜，每一个字都带着湿润的气音。

    “你现在体内灵力只剩不到三成，瞬身步一天只能用一次。冲出去撞上唐玉，她一根针就能把你扎回去。冲我这边来——我现在运灵力的速度比之前快了一倍，你连我的衣角都摸不到。”

    林尘没有回答。

    他在心里数唐玉的脚步声。

    十三步，十二步。

    “你从密室里跑出来的时候肯定在想，先把门口的唐玉引开，再从我这边突破。但你没想到唐玉会主动离开——她收到陈元的传讯，知道掌门已经搜到后山了。她现在急着守密室，正好跟我撞上。你的运气确实不错，能在念毒和缚灵索的夹击下活下来，但你的运气用完了。走廊里两个方向都有人，你困在中间，匕首没有淬毒，瞬身步只剩最后一次。”

    宋芹的脚步声又往前挪了一截。

    “你的混沌圣体在排毒的时候把我当成垃圾桶，三种毒素全倒进我体内。现在念毒改造了我的经脉，蛛毒在我的血管里重新结晶，火棘丹的副作用让我的灵力运转速度翻了一倍。我倒要谢谢你——要不是你把毒排到我身上，我这辈子都不可能体验到念蜕是什么感觉。”

    唐玉的脚步声停了。

    十一。

    “念蜕？”

    唐玉的声音从走廊另一头传来，语气里带着一种从来没出现过的警惕，“谁在走廊里？”

    宋芹从拐角处走了出来。

    她的脸已经完全变了——肿胀消退了，嘴唇上的深紫色褪成了一种极淡的灰白，像是被什么东西从内部漂白过。

    脸上的抓痕全部消失了，皮肤光滑得不像正常人，反而像一层新长出来的薄膜，紧紧绷在颧骨上。

    她的眼睛里布满了暗紫色的血丝，瞳孔边缘有一圈极其细微的紫色光环，在昏暗的走廊里微微发亮。

    她的后颈上，林尘留下的截脉灵印已经被念毒腐蚀殆尽，取而代之的是一条从发际线延伸到肩胛骨的紫色线痕，像一根被埋进皮肤下面的细针，正在随着她的呼吸微微跳动。

    “是我。”

    宋芹转过身看着唐玉，“你扎在林尘身上的两针念毒，全被他排到我体内了。念蜕之后，我的灵力运转速度快了一倍，经脉不疼不痒，浑身上下轻得像一张纸。说起来——你的念毒被他当成垃圾排出来，倒便宜了我。”

    唐玉没有接话。

    她从袖中抽出银针，针尖在昏暗的灯光下泛着墨绿色的寒光。

    她认出了宋芹后颈上那条紫色线痕——那不是普通的中毒症状，是念毒浓度突破阈值之后侵入神识的标志。

    在火毒宗的记载里，念蜕状态的中毒者会在短时间内获得极强的灵力感知和反应速度，但代价是神识被念毒逐步侵蚀，最终变成没有自主意识的活毒源。

    “你知不知道自己现在是什么状态。”

    唐玉的银针指着宋芹的喉咙，声音冷了下来，“念蜕不是突破。你的灵力运转速度翻倍是因为念毒在燃烧你的经脉潜能。等潜能烧完了，你就会从一个筑基巅峰变成一个连炼气期都不如的废人。这个过程最长不超过三天。”

    “三天？”

    宋芹歪了歪头，“三天够我突破金丹了。只要我在经脉潜能烧完之前冲到金丹期，念毒就会被金丹的灵力自行分解。你的念毒给了我念蜕的机会，我拿他的混沌圣体冲到筑基巅峰——你们两个都是我的贵人。”

    她转过身朝拐角走去。

    “所以他现在不能走。你的截脉灵印封了我半炷香的时间，念毒腐蚀灵印又花了半炷香，这段时间他要是跑了我上哪再找一个混沌圣体。等我把他的灵力榨干冲上金丹，你想带他走随你。”

    唐玉的银针往前送了半寸。

    “陈元要的是活人。”

    “陈元现在自身难保。掌门带着人已经搜到后山了，贺九那边三个打一个到现在还没拿下玉玲珑，血煞宗的人拖不住多久。你还指望陈元回来炼人傀？”

    宋芹头也不回。

    “他现在唯一的价值就是让我在掌门攻进来之前突破金丹。你帮我守住走廊那头，等我突破金丹之后帮你杀穿血煞宗的人，你带着林尘远走高飞。你答应过你哥的事——火毒宗那边你一个人搞不定。多一个金丹期帮手，比多一个筑基期的废物有用得多。”

    唐玉沉默了。

    林尘听到了银针收回袖中的声音。

    她不是被说服了——她是选择了眼下最有利的方案。

    陈元能不能活着回来已经不确定了，贺九那边战况不利，掌门随时可能突破防线。

    在这种情况下，多一个金丹期的盟友确实比守着一个随时会死的囚犯更有价值。

    但她不知道的是，宋芹的念蜕不是永久性的。

    三天后经脉潜能烧完，她就会变成一个废人。
content_en:
The spiritual stone lamp in the corridor flashed.
Lin Chen's back was pressed against the stone wall at the corner, and the dagger was placed across his chest. The dark purple blood stains from Song Qin's collarbone still remained on the blade.
Seventeen steps away, Tang Yu's footsteps came from the other end of the corridor. His soft-soled boots stepped on the stone slabs in a steady rhythm, not hurriedly nor slowly.
Thirteen steps away, in the direction of the secret room door, the friction sound of Song Qin's cloth dragging on the ground stopped for a moment, and then started again, much closer than before.
"Do you want to rush out with one last instant step?"
Song Qin's voice came from the end of the corridor. It was hoarse with a unique joy after mental transformation, as if a new layer of mucous membrane had grown back after the throat had been soaked by toxins, and every word had a moist breath.
"You have less than 30% of your spiritual power left in your body now, and you can only use the Shun Shen Step once a day. Rush out and bump into Tang Yu, and she can prick you back with a needle. Come to me - I can transport spiritual power twice as fast as before, and you can't even touch the corners of my clothes."
Lin Chen did not answer.
He counted Tang Yu's footsteps in his mind.
Thirteen steps, twelve steps.
"When you ran out of the secret room, you must have been thinking, first lure Tang Yu away from the door, and then break through from my side. But you didn't expect that Tang Yu would leave on his own initiative - she received a message from Chen Yuan and knew that the leader had found the back mountain. She is now anxious to keep the secret.You happened to bump into me in the room.You are really lucky to survive the attack of the mind poison and the soul binding rope, but your luck has run out.There are people in the corridor in both directions. You are trapped in the middle, and the dagger is not quenched, and you only have one last step left."
Song Qin's footsteps moved forward again.
"Your Chaos Holy Body treated me like a trash can when it was detoxifying, and all three types of toxins were poured into my body. Now the thought poison has transformed my meridians, and the spider poison has re-crystallized in my blood vessels. The side effects of the firethorn pill have doubled the speed of my spiritual energy. I would like to thank you - if you hadn't discharged the poison into me, I would never have experienced the feeling of thought transformation in my life."
Tang Yu's footsteps stopped.
eleven.
"Nian Shen?"
Tang Yu's voice came from the other end of the corridor, with a vigilance in his tone that had never appeared before, "Who is in the corridor?"
Song Qin walked out from the corner.
Her face had completely changed—the swelling had gone away, and the deep purple on her lips had faded to a very pale gray, as if something had bleached it from within.
All the scratches on his face have disappeared, and the skin is not as smooth as a normal person. Instead, it is like a newly grown film, tightly stretched on the cheekbones.
Her eyes were covered with dark purple bloodshot eyes, and there was an extremely fine purple halo around the edge of her pupils, which shone slightly in the dim corridor.
On the back of her neck, the pulse-cutting spirit mark left by Lin Chen had been corroded by the mind poison, and was replaced by a purple line extending from the hairline to the shoulder blade, like a thin needle buried under the skin, beating slightly with her breathing.
"It's me."
Song Qin turned around and looked at Tang Yu, "The two needles of mind poison you stabbed into Lin Chen's body were all expelled into my body. After the mind transformation, my spiritual energy circulated twice as fast, my meridians felt no pain or itching, and my whole body was as light as a piece of paper. Speaking of which - he treated your mind poison as garbage and expelled it, which really benefited me."
Tang Yu didn't answer.
She took out the silver needle from her sleeve, and the needle tip glowed with a dark green cold light in the dim light.
She recognized the purple line mark on the back of Song Qin's neck - it was not an ordinary poisoning symptom, it was a sign that the mind poison had invaded the consciousness after the concentration exceeded the threshold.
According to the records of the Fire Poison Sect, the poisoned person in the state of mental transformation will gain extremely strong spiritual perception and reaction speed in a short period of time, but the price is that the spiritual consciousness is gradually eroded by the mental poison, and eventually becomes a living poison source without independent consciousness.
"Do you know what state you are in now?"
Tang Yu's silver needle pointed at Song Qin's throat, and his voice became colder, "Nian Shen is not a breakthrough. The speed of your spiritual power has doubled because the mental poison is burning the potential of your meridians. When the potential is burned out, you will transform from a peak foundation-building person into a useless person who is not even as good as the Qi refining period. This process will not exceed three days at most."
"Three days?"
Song Qin tilted her head, "Three days are enough for me to break through the golden elixir. As long as I reach the golden elixir stage before the potential of the meridians is burned out, the thought poison will be decomposed by the spiritual power of the golden elixir. Your thought poison gave me the opportunity to transform, and I will use his chaotic holy body to rush to the peak of foundation building - you two are my nobles."
She turned and walked around the corner.
"So he can't leave now. Your pulse cutting spirit seal took me half a stick of incense, and it took another half stick of incense to corrode the spirit seal with the thought poison. If he runs away during this time, where can I find another Chaos Holy Body? When I drain his spiritual power and rush to the golden elixir, you can take him away with you if you want."
Tang Yu's silver needle moved forward half an inch.
"Chen Yuan wants a living person."
"Chen Yuan can't protect himself now. The leader and his people have already searched the back mountain. He Jiu's side has been beating three of them one by one and they haven't captured Yu Linglong yet. The people of the Blood Evil Sect can't hold it off for long. Do you still expect Chen Yuan to come back and make human puppets?"
Song Qin didn't look back.
"His only value now is to let me break through the Golden Core before the leader attacks. You help me guard the end of the corridor, and after I break through the Golden Core, I will help you kill the people of the Blood Evil Sect. You take Lin Chen away and fly away. You promised your brother that you can't handle the Fire Poison Sect alone. An extra helper in the Golden Core stage is much more useful than a waste in the Foundation Establishment stage."
Tang Yu was silent.
Lin Chen heard the sound of the silver needle being withdrawn into his sleeve.
She wasn't convinced - she chose the most advantageous option at the moment.
It was no longer certain whether Chen Yuan could come back alive. The battle situation on He Jiu's side was unfavorable, and the leader might break through the defense line at any time.
In this case, having an extra golden elixir-level ally is indeed more valuable than guarding a prisoner who could die at any time.
But what she didn't know was that Song Qin's transformation was not permanent.
After three days, the potential of her meridians is burned out, and she will become a disabled person.
